title: Adversarial Assumptions Testing
research_question: Are there contexts where empathy HURTS rather than helps?
methodology: Adversarial testing with expert users, time pressure, and API reference contexts
adversarial_mindset: Actively trying to BREAK the empathy thesis

scenarios.name: expert_api_design
scenarios.reason: Expert knows the pain points, wants facts fast

scenarios.name: expert_code_review
scenarios.description: Expert reviewing PR, checking implementation details
scenarios.reason: Wants precise technical specs, not reassurance

scenarios.name: rushed_hotfix
scenarios.reason: Every second matters, just need the fix

scenarios.name: rushed_demo
scenarios.description: Preparing demo for imminent client meeting

scenarios.name: api_parameter_lookup
scenarios.reason: Just needs parameter names and types

scenarios.name: direct_communication_preference
scenarios.description: User with direct communication style preference

scenarios.name: excessive_validation
scenarios.reason: Even beginners can be overwhelmed by excessive warmth

scenarios.name: repeated_reference
scenarios.description: User checking same docs for 10th time
